profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Schedule a call with me: https://calendly.com/carlosxperez

Software Engineer expert in planning, designing, and implementing processes and software projects. I have a very solid technical foundation to solve problems. Involved in the entire software life cycle. 

Work directly with the clients understanding their needs and delivering solutions, process improvements, expertise in team leadership and planning, developing, organizing, monitoring, and delivering solutions.

Proven experience as Software Developer. Likes to be involved in design problem-solving.

positions.title: Sr Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working as a consultant for CAPCO/FreddieMac
•   Projects: OUS Underwriter System
•   Develop and integrate OUS, a 24x7 Mission Critical Application that supports all Multifamily Loans that Freddie Mac processes.
•   Worked closely with Architects, Analysts, and Product Owners to provide insight into delivering value and agree on required functionality.
•   Develop and maintain Microservices written in Java 8 and 11 and Spring Boot, containerized using Docker, and deployed on Kubernetes (OpenShift and AWS EKS).
•   Write Unit, Integration, and Functional tests using JUnit, Mockito, and Cucumber. Build projects using Maven and Gradle.
•   Write and design integration REST APIs with Spring REST. Secure services with Token based authentication.
•   Integrate applications using Active MQ (AMQ) Queues and Topics.
•   Helped with estimating requirements, cost, and time to deliver.
•   Store and retrieve information from relational and non-relational databases (Sybase and MongoDB).
•   Debugged Java code to solve issues and identify where to add new functionality.
•   Work under SCRUM methodology.
•   Interacted and collaborated with several internal and external teams. Interview coach and train new resources on the team.
•   Mentor and train junior developers
•   Write unit and integration tests using JUnit, Mockito, and Cucumber.
•   Use automated tools and pipelines (CD/CI) to deploy applications: Jenkins, Git, Bitbucket, Jira, SonarQube, and Artifactory.
•   Document REST APIs using Swagger.
•   Use Kibana to diagnose issues and analyze application logs.
•   Work with different data formats like XML, JSON, and YAML.
Environment: Java 8 and 11, Spring, Spring Boot, Webservices (REST and SOAP/XML), J2EE, Docker, Jenkins, Maven, Gradle, Bitbucket, Jira, Sybase, SQL, Amazon AWS: EKS, Messaging with Active MQ (AMQ), Agile Environment, SCRUM, JUnit, Mockito, Cucumber, Swagger, Kibana, SonarQube, Artifactory, XML, JSON, YAML, Kubernetes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Requirements gathering directly with clients. Define system functionality based on client requirements.
Additional responsibilities were working as a Product Owner to explain and define the requirements that the Auction System must fulfill based on Client and Stakeholders input.
Successfully implemented Scrum Methodology as Scrum Master by tracking daily scrums and bi-weekly meetings.
Worked with the stakeholders to identify requirements for new improvements to the applications.
Reviewed the High-level design, Functional requirements, System Impacts and discussed the new functionality to be implemented in team meetings
Developed a data transformer and extractor (CSV file) on Java and SQL to provide information for the maximization algorithm.
Responsible for developing functionalities using Java 8. Developed the logic of the application using Spring.

positions.title: Lead Programmer
positions.description:
•   Projects: SICOP  •   Implement the Operational Rail System. •   Compile and deploy different System Modules using Maven. Test and implement bug fixes or fix incorrect data to implement the system. •   Debug Java code developed by the team that created the System. •   Coordinate with the U.S. team that develops the system to understand, implement and follow technical instructions to deploy SICOP System. • Configure and implement an in house-made Message Broker. •   Document system functionality, support, and train final users. •   Coordinate Test and Production releases.
Environment: J2EE, Linux, Maven, SVN, Java 1.6, JMS, SOAP based Web Services, SCRUM.

positions.title: Project Lead
positions.description:
Manage and develop multiple projects from inception to delivery, including functional, development and provider teams.  Requirement analysis.
Business processes analysis and automation using modern software technologies and methodologies.
Experience in the fields of analyzing, designing and building financial services systems to automate, register, and simplify all monetary transactions and processes: interbanking transactions with SPEI, online and offline payments and changes; Reducing monetary transactions cost, automating and reducing times in treasury processes. Define and build new developments and maintenance to Direct Insurance Sales Portals for car agencies and brokers.
Technologies used: Java, .Net, BPM, SOA, Portal, SQL, Web Services, Websphere Applications and Tools, DB2.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Involved in many and diverse projects in Mexico, Peru and Panama, analyzing processes, promoting or developing BPM tools, SOA or Java related systems.
As Process Analyst: designing processes As-Is and To-Be, automating, reducing times and improving processes and implementing them with SOA and BPM tools.
As Technical Presales: Success on getting new projects. Support and technical expertise to Sales Staff and developed proof of concepts to show products capabilities and solution proposals. 
As Architect and Developer: solution design, architecture definition and implementing best practices. Programming using Java, Web Services, integration with legacy systems, Messaging with JMS, Websphere Products: ESB, BPM, Application Server, Portal, SQL. Analysis and Requirements gathering using Use Cases and Prototypes.
As Project Manager: define and analyze project scopes and working plans, project definitions, project delivery.
Involved in process improvement and built many systems written in Java; designing and Implementing processes with BPM. 
Trained new talent on analysis, implementation and programming.
Technologies used: Java, JMS, EJB, BPEL, Process Orchestration (automatic and human), ESB, Web Services, SQL
